$comment: DILIM'S SATCHEL: what Lola taught her to carry, found in the woods and dropped by aswang.
Kent's design: none of these is in the fifty and none is drawable -- 'The brush is the apo's.
These are lola's.' So they never go through the bag or the recogniser: they stack here, with
a visible count, and four of them sit on quick slots (Z X C V) because a fight has no time for
a menu. The slots fill in the order things are first picked up.
`cap` is how many she can carry; `drop_chance` is the share of aswang that drop one when they
fall (one roll per item, so a fall can drop nothing or more than one). `never_in_finale` keeps
the lantern from being refilled mid-night: 'Langis carried in is what the player has.'
`finale_waves` lets a row drop only in those of the finale's waves (0-indexed) and never
outside it. An item in the satchel that does nothing is a bug, not a placeholder.
`found` is what she says finding the first of a kind: what it does, the key it is on ({key})
and when it is for. Naming it and its key alone left a player with a candle and no idea what for.
`does` stands under its name on the quick slot, for as long as she carries it: said once and
gone was the whole trouble (Kent: 'not that clear to use and when to use'). Short enough to fit
under its slot at the readable floor. `moment` is said the first time it is the right thing to
press, when level_4.gd's _wanted_now says so and the slot lights up. `night` is what she says
of it as the last clearing starts. None of these may name a drawable class: the audit reads them.

lines.$comment: Said of any of them. {name} and {gloss} are the row's; {key} the slot's, as bound.
lines.no_slot: {name}, {gloss}. All four slots are full: use up one of my things and it moves in.
lines.moved_in: A slot is free. {name} is on {key} now.

asin.found: Asin, salt. {key} throws it ahead of me, and it burns whatever it lands on.
asin.moment: In reach. {key} throws salt, and it burns.
asin.night: {key} throws salt. It burns what it lands on.
asin.$comment: Thrown in an arc. Burns aswang flesh: three ticks of one over 2.4 s. The only thing that kills a manananggal's lower half.

abo.found: Abo, ash. {key} throws it up, to show what hides close by. Keep it for what I cannot see.
abo.moment: It is close. {key}, now: ash shows it.
abo.night: {key} is the ash. It only reaches close by: wait until its slot says Now.
abo.too_far: Nothing near enough. Ash only reaches this close.
abo.$comment: Thrown into the air where she stands: it hangs there, blinds what it touches for a moment, and shows what hides in shadow.

bawang.found: Bawang, garlic. {key} crushes it at my feet, and they will not cross the ring for ten seconds.
bawang.moment: Too close. {key} crushes garlic. Stay inside the ring.
bawang.night: {key} crushes garlic. They will not cross the ring for ten seconds.
bawang.used: Ten seconds inside the ring. Stay in it.
bawang.$comment: Crushed where she stands: for ten seconds nothing that hunts by smell will cross into it. Defensive -- room to draw.

kandila.found: Kandila, a candle. {key} sets it at my feet: light on this spot, no ink. For when the lamp is low.
kandila.moment: I can barely see. {key} sets the candle down.
kandila.night: {key} sets the candle down, when the lamp gets low.
kandila.used: It burns here for 45 seconds. It does not follow me.
kandila.not_the_answer: A candle shows the way, but this wants a light I draw.
kandila.$comment: A light that costs no ink, set down where she stands, burning for 45 s. What a player hoards for the last clearing.

langis.found: Langis, lamp oil. {key} pours it in, two stages back on the lamp. For when it burns low.
langis.moment: The lamp is low. {key} pours the oil.
langis.night: {key} pours the oil, when the lamp gets low.
langis.full: The lamp is full. I will keep the oil.
langis.$comment: Two stages back into the lantern. The healing item, and the scarcest. Never dropped in the last clearing.

buntot_pagi.found: Buntot Pagi, Lola's whip. {key} lashes ahead of me, even at what flies.
buntot_pagi.moment: {key} lashes the whip. It reaches what flies.
buntot_pagi.$comment: Lola's whip, the satchel's one weapon: its row is weapons.json's (10 lashes, 3 damage, 130 reach, a 160 degree arc, 0.45 s between). It reaches what flies. Dropped only in the finale's second and third waves.
